name: Mark of Implacable Hunting
body:
School divination; Level druid 5, inquisitor 5, ranger 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

You mark a target as your quarry. As long as the target is on the same plane, you know the distance and direction the creature is in relation to you. You also know if it is moving and if so, in what direction. You gain a + 10 bonus to Perception checks to notice the target if it is using Stealth or recognize it if it is using Disguise. If the target succeeds on their saving throw, this spell instead acts as the spell tracking mark except its duration is 1 hour per level.
